features.name: AutoForge self-hosting
features.description: Use AutoForge to govern implementation work on its own repository.

features.name: Virdua design pilot
features.description: Validate a linked Virdua screen design specification through AutoForge context delivery.

features.name: Virdua design pilot
features.description: Validate a linked Virdua screen design specification through AutoForge context delivery.

features.name: v0.8 intent and knowledge
features.description: Convert human intent into structured, triaged, research-aware project knowledge without breaking v0.7 contracts.

phases.name: Dogfood safety feedback
phases.description: Address concrete safety and ergonomics findings exposed by the first self-hosted run.

phases.name: Dashboard screen validation
phases.description: Exercise the Virdua dashboard screen, component, token, state, and flow graph.

phases.name: Schema decisions
phases.description: Resolve the remaining intent, research, readiness, naming, and artifact contract decisions.

tasks.name: Ignore retained migration backups
tasks.description: Ensure complete legacy migration backups remain local recovery artifacts and never appear as commit candidates.

tasks.name: Align self-hosted quality gates
tasks.description: Remove the unavailable legacy lint command so AutoForge quality gates reflect tools installed by this repository.

tasks.name: Terminate timed-out quality process trees
tasks.description: Prevent timed-out npm quality commands from leaving Vitest or other child processes running after the gate returns.

tasks.name: Bound foundation test concurrency
tasks.description: Limit Vitest worker concurrency so bundled CLI and filesystem integration tests remain deterministic under constrained environments.

tasks.name: Exclude managed state from formatting
tasks.description: Keep Prettier focused on authored repository files while preserving the self-hosted format quality gate.

tasks.name: Deliver Virdua dashboard pilot packet
tasks.description: Validate the linked Virdua dashboard specifications and deliver an implementation-ready context packet.

tasks.name: Finalize v0.8 schema contracts
tasks.description: Decide intent storage, intent-to-work relationships, triage precedence, readiness evidence, confidence representation, research provenance, token naming, and planning artifact freshness.

tasks.name: Implement v0.8 knowledge schemas
tasks.description: Add additive intent, research, product, architecture, domain, and API specification metadata with validation tests.

tasks.name: Extend knowledge codec and registry
tasks.description: Preserve intent and research metadata through Markdown serialization and registry persistence.

tasks.name: Implement deterministic intent triage
tasks.description: Classify structured intent with additive labels, explicit evidence, and conflict reporting.

tasks.name: Implement explainable readiness evaluator
tasks.description: Evaluate intent readiness by work kind with explicit evidence, missing fields, categorical levels, and bounded confidence.

tasks.name: Render knowledge context contracts
tasks.description: Include intent and research metadata in compiled context packets without changing packet identity or budget behavior.

tasks.name: Generate modular planning artifacts
tasks.description: Compile intent into independently generated feature, technical, design, story, and acceptance artifacts with freshness metadata.

tasks.name: Compose intent application service
tasks.description: Expose a stable service boundary that evaluates intent, readiness, and requested planning artifacts without CLI coupling.

tasks.name: Test intent assessment command
tasks.description: Cover project-contained intent assessment, artifact generation, and malformed CLI arguments.

tasks.name: Register intent and research artifacts
tasks.description: Persist validated intent and research JSON artifacts through the existing specification registry.

tasks.name: Inspect registered knowledge artifacts
tasks.description: List and show registered intent and research specifications through a focused knowledge command.

tasks.name: Persist planning artifacts
tasks.description: Store generated planning artifacts with fingerprints, generator metadata, and freshness validation.

tasks.name: Persist assessed planning artifacts
tasks.description: Allow intent assessment to persist requested planning artifacts atomically while retaining JSON output.

tasks.name: Report planning artifact freshness
tasks.description: Inspect persisted planning artifacts and report whether they match a supplied source intent fingerprint.

tasks.name: Repair GitHub CI workflow
tasks.description: Align CI with Node 20, npm lockfile installation, current test/build commands, and packed package smoke verification.

tasks.name: Replace legacy agent workflow
tasks.description: Replace the prompt-chain change processor with v0.8 intent, research, triage, readiness, and planning validation.

tasks.name: Convert deployment to release verification
tasks.description: Replace placeholder deployment with tag-driven package and release validation without introducing hosted deployment infrastructure.

tasks.name: Modernize GitHub issue templates
tasks.description: Add AutoForge work, intent, context packet, adapter, and reproduction fields to issue templates.
